vector_representations.body: Unchanged baseline: embed exact passage text.
vector_representations.title_context: Embed document title, one newline, then exact passage text. No paths, IDs, labels, sibling passages or generated text. Returned source excerpt remains unchanged.

lexical_baselines.and: Unchanged runtime plainto_tsquery over the full bounded incident query.
lexical_baselines.or: OR over distinct PostgreSQL English lexemes extracted from the same bounded query; same stored passage terms, ts_rank_cd and C-collation ties. No hybrid fusion, extra index, rank weighting or score cutoff.

control: Verify the prior raw report hash against calibration-development.v1.json, then compare replayed body vector ranks/distances and AND results with that report. Distance tolerance 0.000001. Stop on mismatch.

selection.minimum_vector_mrr: new lexical OR baseline mean over nonempty relevance sets
selection.no_eligible_candidate: preserve null selection without relaxing criteria

promotion: Evaluator-only candidates. No automatic runtime or application-corpus promotion, including if development criteria pass.
limits: No new model or package downloads
